says: The window makes ClientMsg `read` with Schema `make` from the brain's ledger.read answer, whose `rev` is only checked to be a number, while the made field is `Schema.Int`.
proof: In: next/packages/libfabrika/src/client/WindowMachine.ts:1492 decodes the answer as `Entries` (`entries: Schema.Array(Schema.Unknown)`, :415), and :1876 keeps any `e.rev` that passes `Predicate.isNumber`. Make: next/packages/libfabrika/src/client/WindowMachine.ts:1872 `C.ClientMsg.cases.read.make({ rev: Math.max(s.client.seen, ...) })`, whose field is `read: { rev: Schema.Int }` (next/packages/libfabrika/src/runtime/Client.ts:112), so an answer `{"entries":[{"rev":1.5}]}` reaches a make that throws.
cost: A brain answer with a fractional rev kills the window's update with a defect instead of being dropped. Before #1619 the same value went quietly into `client.seen` and threw on the next press, so the gap is older and #1619 moved the throw earlier.
